import subprocess

PREDEFINED_FASTA = "/opt/reference/extra.fa"
PREDEFINED_GTF = "/opt/reference/extra.gtf"

def append_reference(gtf_file, fasta_file):
    for source, destination in ((PREDEFINED_FASTA, fasta_file), (PREDEFINED_GTF, gtf_file)):
        with open(source, "rb") as source_stream:
            subprocess.run(["tee", "-a", destination], stdin=source_stream, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, check=True)

import json
import re
import subprocess
from collections import Counter

def pdf_bag_of_words(pdf_path, output_path):
    result = subprocess.run(["pdftotext", pdf_path, "-"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    counts = Counter(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+", result.stdout.lower()))
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(dict(counts), stream, sort_keys=True)

import csv
import re
import subprocess
from collections import Counter

def pdf_bag_of_words(pdf_path, output_path):
    text = subprocess.check_output(["pdftotext", pdf_path, "-"], text=True)
    counts = Counter(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+", text.lower()))
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream, delimiter='\t')
        writer.writerow(["token", "count"])
        writer.writerows(sorted(counts.items()))

import json
from collections import Counter
from pypdf import PdfReader

def pdf_bag_of_words(pdf_path, output_path):
    text = " ".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(pdf_path).pages)
    counts = Counter(text.lower().split())
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(dict(counts), stream)

import subprocess

def pdf_bag_of_words(pdf_path, output_path):
    result = subprocess.run(["pdftotext", pdf_path, "-"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    tokens = result.stdout.lower().split()
    with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(" ".join(tokens))

import logging
import subprocess

def job_exit_code(job_id):
    result = subprocess.run(["sacct", "-j", str(job_id), "--noheader", "--parsable2", "--format=State,ExitCode"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    state, exit_code = result.stdout.strip().split("|", 1)
    logging.info("job %s state %s", job_id, state)
    return int(exit_code.split(":", 1)[0])

def job_exit_code(job_id):
    output = subprocess.check_output(["sacct", "-X", "-n", "-P", "-o", "State,ExitCode", "-j", str(job_id)], text=True)
    state, raw_code = output.strip().split("|", 1)
    logging.info("job %s state %s", job_id, state)
    primary_code, _signal = raw_code.split(":", 1)
    return int(primary_code)

import logging
import subprocess

def job_exit_code(job_id):
    result = subprocess.run(["squeue", "-j", str(job_id), "-h", "-o", "%T"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    state = result.stdout.strip()
    logging.info("job %s state %s", job_id, state)
    return 0 if state == "COMPLETED" else 1
